Animal weights in pounds:
- Elephant: \(3 \times 2000 = 6000\)
- Donkey: \(10\%\) of \(6000 = 600\)
- Giraffe: \(1.5 \times 2000 = 3000\)
- Hippopotamus: \(4000 \times 2.2 = 8800\)

Animal total: \(6000 + 600 + 3000 + 8800 = 18400\)

Food weights in pounds:
- Donkey: \(5\)
- Elephant: \(16 \text{ oz} = 1\)
- Giraffe: \(3 \times 2.2 = 6.6\)
- Hippopotamus: \(5000 \text{ g} = 5 \times 2.2 = 11\)

Food total: \(5 + 1 + 6.6 + 11 = 23.6\)

Combined weight: \(18400 + 23.6 = 18423.6\)

\boxed{18423.6}
